verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Chargebee can ingest usage events for usage-based billing, but nothing documents real-time visibility of current-cycle usage or accrued cost for customers or the team. Nor is there evidence of usage thresholds or pre-invoice alerts. Usage ingestion, quotes and generic webhooks are only building blocks or adjacent features, so they earn no credit toward this story.

support.subject: As an ops user, customers and my team can see current-cycle usage and accrued cost in real time, with thresholds and alerts before an invoice surprises anyone
